title: Spatial immune remodeling during neoadjuvant therapy in hepatocellular carcinoma: Mechanisms, clinical implications, and future perspectives

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Spatial immune remodeling during neoadjuvant therapy in hepatocellular carcinoma: Mechanisms, clinical implications, and future perspectives》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】Neoadjuvant therapy aims to reduce tumor burden and postoperative recurrence risk in high-risk HCC, while also providing a unique opportunity to preoperatively remodel the tumor microenvironment (TME).
